owner_and_capability: People Directory — the retained repositories of database/repositories/users (people-directory/postgres), contract step for #2727: the package reads the tenant and the transaction through a consumer-owned Runtime port bound by the owner's composition, names the shared repository shapes through the models/users vocabulary, and its suites compose through test support instead of the legacy composition
atomic_cutover: One code-only change: database/repositories/users drops its imports of auth/authorize, auth/authorize/permissions, database/repositories/base, internal/timezone, models/base and tenant. Its constructors take a Runtime (ambient transaction, tenant, transaction and savepoint runner) that modules/peopledirectory/compose.LegacyRepositoryRuntime binds over the tenant runtime and database/repositories passes in; the generic base repository becomes explicit CRUD methods with literal table expressions and a local query-option applicator; DatabaseError, the not-found sentinel, the query shapes and the unique-violation checks come through the models/users vocabulary; calendar dates use sharedkernel/calendar. The default guardian role is bound by the composition through a WithGuardianDefaultRole option over modules/securityruntime, and the helpers the legacy composition took from this package for the caller's school and the permission matcher move to peopledirectory/compose and modules/securityruntime. The 39 suites stay external tests and compose through services/people_repository_suites.go behind api/testutil, naming rows through test. The stale policy rule communication.messages.workflow-people-postgres is deleted.
